newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Brazil stresses growing trade ties with Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: Brazil stresses growing trade ties with Venezuela.

text.p: Brazilian Foreign Minister Luis Felipe Lampreia stressed Thursday his country's growing trade relations with Venezuela, which may join Mercosur by the end of the year.
"Our governments have done everything... the fundamental documents have been signed. Now what we have to do is pin down Venezuela's association with Mercosur," Lampreia told reporters.
Although neighbours, Venezuelan-Brazilian bilateral trade has grown from a low base over the past three years.
Venezuela is now Brazil's second largest oil supplier after Argentina, at some 100,000 barrels per day. And total non-oil trade reached $443 million in 1995, 36 percent up from 1994 levels.
Lampreia is in Caracas until Friday as part of the two-day Fifth Bilateral Venezuelan/Brazilian Commission that covers trade, as well as border security and energy co-operation.
